shared_or_similar_visual_information: Shading restricted to parts of a figure by internal boundaries. On the left, use the four light-blue sectors at the corners of the square. On the right, use the light-blue center of the square bordered by four unshaded corner sectors.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The coloring selects the four quarter disks while excluding the white center. Right image: It selects the center remaining after removing the four corner sectors from the square.
Rationales: The left fill selects separated pieces whose areas are accumulated. The right fill selects a connected remainder after excluding the adjacent unshaded pieces.
